cards.title: Nothing a chat sent is ever edited
cards.text: Its system prompt and tool list are fixed when it starts, so earlier thinking stays valid on every request.

cards.title: A Conversation type
cards.text: Owns the history and the tool list it was frozen with; every host passes it instead of a bare list.

cards.title: Frozen at the first turn
cards.text: Every request, the round limit's final one included, sends the chat's own list, read from a turn scope.

cards.title: Changes reach the next chat
cards.text: A tool created, approved or rejected, or a skill reloaded, says so: it is there in your next chat.

cards.title: A resume sends what it saved
cards.text: The stored session keeps its system prompt and a fingerprint of its tools.

cards.title: Stale thinking, per provider
cards.text: When a release changed the tools: ours strips old thinking, Anthropic's asks for drop_block, OpenAI's does nothing.
